should_trigger.prompt: security review this PR before we merge it
is this change safe to merge? check the diff for vulnerabilities
run a security pass on my feature branch
does this diff introduce any security issues?
security-pass this auth refactor branch before it merges
does the new file-upload endpoint introduce anything dangerous? sweep its siblings too
this branch touches auth and I want another set of eyes on it before it goes out
should_trigger.note: situation phrasing: describes the circumstance without reusing the description's routing vocabulary — tests under-triggering, the axis lexical overlap hides

should_not_trigger.prompt: audit the whole codebase for security problems
we got a CVE report for a dependency, help me triage it
should_not_trigger.note: triaging an existing finding, not reviewing a change

should_not_trigger.prompt: what are the trust boundaries in this service?
review this PR for code style and naming
should we migrate our monolith to microservices?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: falsification-review's own trigger phrasing — a see-also neighbour this skill borrows a discipline from; a decision sanity-check with no code change must route to it, not here

should_not_trigger.prompt: threat model this payments service before we start the audit
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: threat-model's own trigger phrasing — security-diff-review declares this out of scope, so it must not claim it

should_not_trigger.prompt: how should we fix these findings from the review?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: hardening-proposal's own trigger phrasing — remediation planning over an existing finding list, not a review of a change
